info.title: CIC General Insurance: Broker API Integration Guide
info.description:
This is a sample specification for illustration. Endpoints, fields, and codes are examples, not a production contract.

**Version:** 1.0 (sample) · **Audience:** Broker systems and software integrators · **Subsidiary:** CIC General Insurance (GB)

## 1. Overview

The Broker API package lets a licensed broker (or an integrator acting for a broker) run the full general insurance journey with CIC GB: quote, bind, pay, service, claim, and reconcile commission.

### Broker journey

```
Authenticate → Find customer → Browse products → Quote → Proposal → Bind/Issue
→ Pay → Get documents → Endorse / Renew / Cancel → Claims → Commission
```

### Environments

| Environment | Base URL | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Sandbox | `https://sandbox.api.cic.example/gb` | Build and test with mock data |
| Production | `https://api.cic.example/gb` | Live, enabled after certification |

## 2. Versioning

Every API is available in **three major versions**, each with **two minor versions**. (Sample differences, for illustration.)

| Major | Status | Base path | Minor versions | Breaking changes from the previous major |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| v3 | Current | `/v3` | 3.0, 3.1 | Cursor pagination (`cursor`, `limit`) replaces `page`; `X-Request-Id` is required |
| v2 | Supported | `/v2` | 2.0, 2.1 | `page_size` renamed `limit`; `meta.pageSize` renamed `meta.limit` |
| v1 | Deprecated, sunset 2027-06-30 | `/v1` | 1.0, 1.1 | Baseline contract |

**Major version** is part of the URL path (`/v3/quotes`) and may include breaking changes. Old majors stay available until their sunset date.

**Minor version** is selected with the `Api-Version` header (`3.0` or `3.1`). If omitted, `N.0` is used. Minor versions are backward compatible: they only add optional response fields, so a client written for `N.0` keeps working against `N.1`.

Responses echo `Api-Version`. Deprecated majors also return `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers. `/oauth2/token` is not versioned.

**Fields added in minor `N.1`** (same field in every major):

| API | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| Customer lookup | `lastKycCheckAt` | string (date-time) |
| Product catalogue | `catalogueVersion` | string |
| Create quotation | `quoteDocumentUrl` | string (uri) |
| Get quotation | `quoteDocumentUrl` | string (uri) |
| Submit proposal | `estimatedIssueDate` | string (date) |
| Bind and issue policy | `renewalDate` | string (date) |
| Initiate payment | `expiresAt` | string (date-time) |
| Get policy documents | `generatedAt` | string (date-time) |
| Endorse policy | `endorsementDocumentId` | string |
| Get renewal terms | `autoRenewEligible` | boolean |
| Accept renewal | `acceptedAt` | string (date-time) |
| Cancel policy | `refundReference` | string |
| Notify claim (FNOL) | `acknowledgeBy` | string (date-time) |
| Upload claim document | `scanStatus` | string |
| Get claim status | `nextAction` | string |
| Commission statement | `statementPdfUrl` | string (uri) |
| Webhook subscription | `signingAlgorithm` | string |

## 3. Conventions

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Format | JSON over HTTPS, UTF-8 |
| Dates | ISO 8601, e.g. `2026-10-06` or `2026-10-06T09:30:00+03:00` |
| Currency | ISO 4217, default `KES` |
| Idempotency | `Idempotency-Key` header required on all `POST` requests that create or change state |
| Correlation | Send `X-Request-Id` (UUID). CIC echoes it in the response and logs |
| Data scoping | A broker only sees its own customers, quotes, policies, claims, and commission |
| API definitions | Each API in section 4 includes an OpenAPI 3.0 (Swagger) definition |
| Pagination | `?page=1&page_size=50`, response includes `meta.total` |

### Standard error format

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "vehicle.registrationNumber is invalid",
    "details": [{ "field": "vehicle.registrationNumber", "issue": "Format not recognised" }],
    "requestId": "7b1f3c2e-9d2a-4e11-8a55-0c3f6f1d9a10"
  }
}
```

### HTTP status codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 / 201 / 202 | Success / created / accepted for async processing |
| 400 | Validation error |
| 401 | Missing or invalid token |
| 403 | Scope, licence, or broker consent problem |
| 404 | Resource not found, or not owned by the broker |
| 409 | Conflict (duplicate request, invalid state transition) |
| 422 | Business rule failure (for example underwriting decline) |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 5xx | CIC-side error, retry with backoff |

### Rate limits

Default: 20 requests per second per broker, 200 per second per integrator. Headers `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining` are returned on every response.

## 4. API Reference

Paths below are shown without the version prefix. Prefix them with `/v1`, `/v2` or `/v3`, for example `POST /v3/quotes`.

| # | API | Method and path | Journey stage |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Customer Lookup | `GET /customers` | Onboard client |
| 2 | Product Catalogue | `GET /products` | Select product |
| 3 | Create Quotation | `POST /quotes` | Quote |
| 4 | Get Quotation | `GET /quotes/{quoteId}` | Quote |
| 5 | Submit Proposal | `POST /proposals` | Apply |
| 6 | Bind and Issue Policy | `POST /policies` | Issue |
| 7 | Initiate Payment | `POST /payments` | Pay |
| 8 | Get Policy Documents | `GET /policies/{policyNumber}/documents` | Documents |
| 9 | Endorse Policy | `POST /policies/{policyNumber}/endorsements` | Service |
| 10 | Get Renewal Terms | `GET /policies/{policyNumber}/renewal` | Renew |
| 11 | Accept Renewal | `POST /policies/{policyNumber}/renewal` | Renew |
| 12 | Cancel Policy | `POST /policies/{policyNumber}/cancellation` | Cancel |
| 13 | Notify Claim (FNOL) | `POST /claims` | Claim |
| 14 | Upload Claim Document | `POST /claims/{claimNumber}/documents` | Claim |
| 15 | Get Claim Status | `GET /claims/{claimNumber}` | Claim |
| 16 | Commission Statement | `GET /commissions/statements` | Reconcile |
| 17 | Webhook Subscription | `POST /webhooks/subscriptions` | Events |

## 5. End-to-End Example: Motor Policy, New Business

| Step | Call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `POST /oauth2/token` | Access token |
| 2 | `GET /customers?kraPin=...` | Customer found |
| 3 | `GET /products?class=MOTOR` | Product selected |
| 4 | `POST /quotes` | Quote `QT-...` offered |
| 5 | `POST /proposals` | Proposal accepted |
| 6 | `POST /policies` | Policy `PENDING_PAYMENT` |
| 7 | `POST /payments` | STK push sent |
| 8 | Webhook `payment.completed` | Policy becomes `ACTIVE` |
| 9 | `GET /policies/{no}/documents` | Schedule and certificate downloaded |

## 6. Go-Live Checklist

1. Broker agreement with CIC GB is active and licence is valid on the partner record.
2. Sandbox testing passes for all subscribed APIs, including error and retry cases.
3. Idempotency keys implemented on all state-changing calls.
4. Webhook signature verification and deduplication in place.
5. Secrets stored securely, with token refresh handled before expiry.
6. Certification test scenarios signed off by CIC IT.
7. Production credentials issued and rate limits confirmed.

## 7. Support

| Channel | Use |
|---|---|
| Developer portal | Keys, subscriptions, usage dashboard |
| Integration support | `api-support@cic.example` |
| Status page | `https://status.cic.example` |

post.description:
Request an access token using the app credentials issued from the developer portal.

Integrators acting for a broker must also send `X-Broker-Code` on subsequent API calls. The broker must have granted consent in the portal. Calls are rejected with `403 BROKER_CONSENT_MISSING` if consent is absent or revoked.

**Scopes**

| Scope | Allows |
|---|---|
| `customer:read` | Customer lookup |
| `product:read` | Product catalogue |
| `quote:write` | Create and view quotes |
| `policy:write` | Proposals, bind, endorse, renew, cancel |
| `policy:read` | Policy details and documents |
| `payment:write` | Initiate payments |
| `claims:write` | Lodge claims and upload documents |
| `claims:read` | Claim status |
| `commission:read` | Commission statements |

get.description:
> **v3 · Current.** Minor versions `3.0` (default) and `3.1` via the `Api-Version` header. `3.1` adds `lastKycCheckAt`.

Find an existing CIC customer record by identifier. Access is consent-based and limited to customers linked to the broker.

**`GET /v3/customers?kraPin=A001234567Z`**

Scope: `customer:read`

| Query parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kraPin` | string | One of | KRA PIN |
| `nationalId` | string | One of | National ID number |
| `phone` | string | One of | Phone in E.164 format |

**Response `200 OK`**

```json
{
  "customerId": "CUS-884201",
  "type": "INDIVIDUAL",
  "fullName": "Jane Wanjiru Kamau",
  "kraPin": "A001234567Z",
  "phone": "+254712345678",
  "email": "jane.kamau@example.com",
  "kycStatus": "VERIFIED",
  "linkedToBroker": true
}
```

Returns `404 CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND` if no match exists for this broker. Use `POST /v3/customers` (not shown) to register a new customer.

> **v3 · Current.** Minor versions `3.0` (default) and `3.1` via the `Api-Version` header. `3.1` adds `quoteDocumentUrl`.

Calculate a binding premium for a risk.

**`POST /v3/quotes`**

Scope: `quote:write` · Headers: `Idempotency-Key`

**Request**

```json
{
  "productCode": "MTR-PRIV-COMP",
  "customerId": "CUS-884201",
  "effectiveDate": "2026-10-10",
  "termMonths": 12,
  "vehicle": {
    "registrationNumber": "KDG 123A",
    "make": "Toyota",
    "model": "Axio",
    "yearOfManufacture": 2018,
    "sumInsured": 1450000,
    "usage": "PRIVATE"
  },
  "optionalCovers": ["POLITICAL_VIOLENCE", "EXCESS_PROTECTOR"],
  "discountCode": null
}
```

**Response `201 Created`**

```json
{
  "quoteId": "QT-2026-0098123",
  "status": "OFFERED",
  "validUntil": "2026-10-20",
  "currency": "KES",
  "premium": {
    "basic": 58000.00,
    "optionalCovers": 4350.00,
    "levies": 163.25,
    "stampDuty": 40.00,
    "total": 62553.25
  },
  "underwriting": { "decision": "ACCEPT", "referralReasons": [] }
}
```

If underwriting needs a human review, `status` is `REFERRED` and `underwriting.referralReasons` lists the reasons. A decline returns `422 UNDERWRITING_DECLINED`.

| `REFERRED` | Awaiting underwriter decision |
| `EXPIRED` | Past `validUntil` |
| `CONVERTED` | Already bound to a policy |

Submit the signed proposal details for an accepted quote.

**`POST /v3/proposals`**

Scope: `policy:write` · Headers: `Idempotency-Key`

**Request**

```json
{
  "quoteId": "QT-2026-0098123",
  "declarations": {
    "previousInsurer": "XYZ Insurance",
    "claimsInLast3Years": 0,
    "disclosureAccepted": true
  },
  "financeInterest": { "hasFinancier": false },
  "documents": [
    { "type": "LOGBOOK", "documentId": "DOC-55102" },
    { "type": "ID_COPY", "documentId": "DOC-55103" }
  ],
  "signedAt": "2026-10-06T10:15:00+03:00"
}
```

**Response `201 Created`**

```json
{
  "proposalId": "PR-2026-0045512",
  "quoteId": "QT-2026-0098123",
  "status": "ACCEPTED",
  "requirementsOutstanding": []
}
```

Possible `status` values: `ACCEPTED`, `PENDING_DOCUMENTS`, `REFERRED`.

post.description:
> **v3 · Current.** Minor versions `3.0` (default) and `3.1` via the `Api-Version` header. `3.1` adds `renewalDate`.

Convert an accepted proposal into an in-force policy. For motor business, CIC also issues the insurance certificate through the national motor certificate registry.

**`POST /v3/policies`**

Scope: `policy:write` · Headers: `Idempotency-Key`

**Request**

```json
{
  "proposalId": "PR-2026-0045512",
  "paymentMode": "PAY_NOW",
  "commencementDate": "2026-10-10"
}
```

| `paymentMode` | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `PAY_NOW` | Policy activates once payment is confirmed |
| `CREDIT` | Broker credit terms apply (requires approved credit limit) |
| `PREMIUM_FINANCE` | Activated against a premium finance agreement |

**Response `201 Created`**

```json
{
  "policyNumber": "GB/MTR/2026/0071234",
  "status": "PENDING_PAYMENT",
  "premiumDue": 62553.25,
  "currency": "KES",
  "paymentReference": "PAY-GB-0071234",
  "certificate": null
}
```

When payment is confirmed, `status` becomes `ACTIVE` and the certificate details are available via the documents API and the `policy.issued` webhook.

> **v3 · Current.** Minor versions `3.0` (default) and `3.1` via the `Api-Version` header. `3.1` adds `expiresAt`.

Trigger a payment request, for example an M-Pesa STK push to the customer.

**`POST /v3/payments`**

Scope: `payment:write` · Headers: `Idempotency-Key`

**Request**

```json
{
  "paymentReference": "PAY-GB-0071234",
  "method": "MPESA_STK",
  "amount": 62553.25,
  "currency": "KES",
  "payer": { "phone": "+254712345678" }
}
```

| `method` | Description |
|---|---|
| `MPESA_STK` | STK push to payer phone |
| `MPESA_PAYBILL` | Returns paybill and account number for manual payment |
| `CARD` | Returns a hosted payment link |
| `BANK_TRANSFER` | Returns bank account and reference |

**Response `202 Accepted`**

```json
{
  "paymentId": "PMT-9981230",
  "status": "PENDING",
  "message": "Payment request sent to +254712345678"
}
```

The final outcome arrives through the `payment.completed` or `payment.failed` webhook. Do not mark a policy as paid until you receive it.

> **v3 · Current.** Minor versions `3.0` (default) and `3.1` via the `Api-Version` header. `3.1` adds `endorsementDocumentId`.

Change cover mid-term, for example change vehicle, sum insured, or add an optional cover.

**`POST /v3/policies/{policyNumber}/endorsements`**

Scope: `policy:write` · Headers: `Idempotency-Key`

**Request**

```json
{
  "endorsementType": "ADD_OPTIONAL_COVER",
  "effectiveDate": "2026-11-01",
  "changes": { "optionalCovers": ["WINDSCREEN"] },
  "reason": "Customer request"
}
```

| `endorsementType` | Description |
|---|---|
| `ADD_OPTIONAL_COVER` | Add or remove optional covers |
| `CHANGE_SUM_INSURED` | Adjust sum insured |
| `CHANGE_VEHICLE` | Replace the insured vehicle |
| `CHANGE_DETAILS` | Update customer or contact details |
| `ADD_FINANCIER` | Note a financier interest |

**Response `201 Created`**

```json
{
  "endorsementId": "END-2026-0003345",
  "status": "APPROVED",
  "premiumAdjustment": 1250.00,
  "direction": "ADDITIONAL",
  "newTotalPremium": 63803.25
}
```

`status` may be `PENDING_APPROVAL` when underwriter review is required.

> **v3 · Current.** Minor versions `3.0` (default) and `3.1` via the `Api-Version` header. `3.1` adds `autoRenewEligible`.

Retrieve renewal terms for a policy approaching expiry. Available from 60 days before expiry.

**`GET /v3/policies/{policyNumber}/renewal`**

Scope: `policy:read`

**Response `200 OK`**

```json
{
  "policyNumber": "GB/MTR/2026/0071234",
  "expiryDate": "2027-10-09",
  "renewalOffer": {
    "offerId": "RN-2027-0011890",
    "validUntil": "2027-10-09",
    "premium": { "total": 59800.00, "currency": "KES" },
    "ncdApplied": "20%",
    "changesFromExpiring": ["Sum insured revalued to KES 1,300,000"]
  }
```

**Webhook delivery example**

```http
POST https://broker.example.com/hooks/cic
Content-Type: application/json
X-CIC-Signature: sha256=3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b

  "data": {
    "paymentId": "PMT-9981230",
    "paymentReference": "PAY-GB-0071234",
    "policyNumber": "GB/MTR/2026/0071234",
    "amount": 62553.25,
    "receiptNumber": "RCT-2026-558102"
  }
}
```

- Verify `X-CIC-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using your secret).
- Respond `2xx` within 5 seconds. Otherwise CIC retries with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.
- Deduplicate using `X-CIC-Event-Id`.

**Webhook delivery example**

```http
POST https://broker.example.com/hooks/cic
Content-Type: application/json
X-CIC-Signature: sha256=3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
X-CIC-Event-Id: evt_01HW8Z9K

    "paymentId": "PMT-9981230",
    "paymentReference": "PAY-GB-0071234",

}
```

- Verify `X-CIC-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using your secret).

- Deduplicate using `X-CIC-Event-Id`.

Subscribe to events instead of polling.

**`POST /v1/webhooks/subscriptions`**

Scope: `policy:read`

**Request**

```json

  "callbackUrl": "https://broker.example.com/hooks/cic",

```

**Response `201 Created`**

```json

```

**Webhook delivery example**

```http
POST https://broker.example.com/hooks/cic
Content-Type: application/json
X-CIC-Signature: sha256=3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
X-CIC-Event-Id: evt_01HW8Z9K

{
  "event": "payment.completed",
  "occurredAt": "2026-10-06T10:22:41+03:00",
  "data": {
    "paymentId": "PMT-9981230",
    "paymentReference": "PAY-GB-0071234",
    "policyNumber": "GB/MTR/2026/0071234",
    "amount": 62553.25,
    "receiptNumber": "RCT-2026-558102"
  }
}
```

**Handling rules**
- Verify `X-CIC-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using your secret).
- Respond `2xx` within 5 seconds. Otherwise CIC retries with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.
- Deduplicate using `X-CIC-Event-Id`.
